verdicts.reason: The repo matches the claim: D-2-6 -> D-2-2 and D-2-6 -> D-2-3 both carry `abroad: true` with the note 'Usually after the exchange ends: apply anew'. The MOJ student guideline has a '자격변경의 특례' section that allows an in-Korea change to a regular course and asks only for the usual change/extension documents. I found the sibling D-2-8 clause of that section verbatim through search. I could not bring up the D-2-6 clause itself (WebFetch fails DNS for every host and the search budget ran out), and the guideline copy is the 2022 edition, but nothing I found says otherwise. D-2-2 and D-2-3 both have a 'change' list, so the edge is expressible. Side effect: in visadocs.js a move between two D-2 sub-codes only gets a document list from a `within` rule, so the docs page needs one too.

verdicts.reason: Correct that D-2-7 has no `gives` (and no `needs`), and that factsAt(level) applies the current visa's gives. A node run against the real YAML shows the effect for a reader who answered edu=1 (not Korean) and is standing on D-2-7: D-10-1 is always BLOCKED, and E-7-1 and E-7-3 are also BLOCKED once experience is answered. 'Every useful option BLOCKED' overstates it: E-7-2 and F-2-R stay open, and E-7-1/E-7-3 show as 'maybe' while experience is blank. The fix level is wrong. D-2-7 covers '전문학사 이상', so the only guaranteed level is an associate degree. `{edu: 3, koreanEdu: 3}` would over-credit associate-course holders; `{edu: 2, koreanEdu: 2}` already opens E-7-1, E-7-3 and D-10-1 (verified in the simulation).

verdicts.reason: The `{stem: true}` alternative stands for a real exception, so the claim that 'there is no STEM-only route' is wrong. The degree rule is only 'in principle' (원칙으로). Special research institutes (KAIST, GIST, DGIST, UNIST, UST) and, since the MOJ expansion, Korean universities in the THE top 200 / QS top 500 may invite STEM students who are still in a bachelor's programme abroad as D-2-5 research students. The repo's own D-2-5 'abroad' list, copied from 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1, records this. In the engine, `stem` can only be true when edu >= 1 (readDetails), so the 'no degree' case is a high-school graduate studying STEM, which is the exception population. Dropping the alternative would block legitimate applicants. The engine cannot express the condition about the inviting university.
verdicts.source: 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 유학(D-2) › 사증발급 일반 › 2. 제출서류 (D-2-5 course-specific documents), as copied in data/visadocs.yaml targets D-2-5.abroad; 법무부 보도 (hellodd.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=104582; etoday.co.kr/news/view/2375280)

verdicts.reason: The claim is right, and verified-by-review.md already lists it as confirmed wrong (#2). The 80-point floor applies only to notified-country nationals holding B-1, B-2, C-1, C-3, C-4, D-3, E-9, E-10 or G-1, and D-2 is not among them. The proposed note needs two changes. 'Master's or doctorate holder' is wrong: D-10-1 requires a bachelor's or higher, and some D-2-5 holders are STEM bachelor's students under the exception. It also drops the totals, which the existing text has right: 60-79 points gives 6 months at a time and 1 year in total; 80+ gives 1 year at a time and up to 3 years. The same note sits on D-4-1/2/6/7 and F-3 outside this slice.

verdicts.reason: In the repo, D-2-2 and D-2-3 list D-10-2 and D-2-1 and D-2-4 do not. D-10-2 requires a Korean associate degree or a foreign bachelor's or higher, plus one of the IP, OASIS or K-Startup conditions. Only E-9, E-10 and G-1 are barred from changing to it, so Korean associate-degree and doctoral graduates on D-2 qualify. D-10-2 has a 'change' list. In the engine, D-2-1 gives koreanEdu 2 and D-2-4 gives koreanEdu 5, which satisfies D-10-2's needs [{edu:3},{koreanEdu:2}]. The simulation shows D-10-2 OPEN from both.

verdicts.reason: D-2-7.next really has only 7 entries and lacks F-2-7, D-8-4, D-10-2 and E-3. D-2-7 is a Korean degree course from 전문학사 upward, so its graduates have the same exits as D-2-1 to D-2-4. The fix needs three changes. (1) The '10-point bonus for D-2-7' comes from the 2022 guideline's 【참고】; I could not confirm it in the current F-2-7 points table (법무부고시 제2025-408호), so it should not go into a note. (2) D-2-7 also covers associate and bachelor's courses, so the F-2-7 note should cover both tracks; the existing D-10-1 -> F-2-7 note (all four languages, visamap.yaml line 524) does. (3) D-8-4 and D-10-2 only open for readers who answered their education if D-2-7 also gets the d2#2 gives; the simulation with gives {edu:2,koreanEdu:2} shows F-2-7, D-8-4 and D-10-2 OPEN and E-3 correctly BLOCKED for a high-school reader.
